facts: Between the Karakum Desert and the Köpetdag mountains
worth_knowing: Founded in 1881 on the basis of an Ahal Teke tribal village. Much of it was destroyed by the 1948 earthquake and rebuilt, with monumental projects sheathed in white marble.
